title: Fix control loop timer interval scaling
description: `iRoastControl Software/ControlClass.cs` defines `deltaTime` as seconds (`0.5`) but `initialize()` assigns `t.Interval = deltaTime/1000`. `System.Timers.Timer.Interval` is milliseconds, so the loop is configured around `0.0005 ms` instead of the intended `500 ms`. Change the conversion to milliseconds, then verify the roast control loop updates at the intended cadence.
